title: A modular-storage proof of NP-completeness for chip-firing halting on simple digraphs

source_support.reading: function/interface inventory only, not full program audit

claimed_result: NP-completeness under deterministic polynomial-time many-one reductions for ordinary conservative HALTING on finite loopless simple strongly connected digraphs with nonnegative binary configurations; also oriented graphs.
